insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 45% women's / 37% men's. Alo skews 31% women's, Gymshark 21% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +9% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (155) vs Lululemon (171). Gap of 16 to close.
Leggings opportunity: Lululemon has 197 vs Vuori's 171. Gap of 26 SKUs.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 45% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1438 vs 1191 products. A 21% advantage.
Vuori ranks #3 in shorts with 662 products. Behind Gymshark (1236).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 512 products vs Lululemon's 606. Key for cooler weather expansion.

alerts.message: On Running has 2x Vuori's catalog size
